name: workflow-pdf-pro
description: Workflow PDF Pro — lokal gebündelter unveränderter Workflow-PDF-Kern mit nativen Geräteadaptern

scripts.test: npm run verify:upstream && npm test --prefix upstream/workflow-pdf
scripts.sync:android: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew --no-daemon --max-workers=2 assembleRelease
scripts.test:native-web: npm run build:web && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tools/native/test-web-bundle.mjs tools/native/test-file-adapter.mjs tools/native/test-folder-import.mjs tools/native/test-incoming.mjs tools/native/test-vault-product.mjs tools/native/test-tresorordner.mjs tools/native/test-ohne-web.mjs tools/native/test-sicherung.mjs tools/native/test-hintergrund.mjs tools/native/test-hintergrund-dienst.mjs tools/native/test-scan-direkt.mjs tools/native/test-bedienung-pin.mjs tools/native/test-pro-bedienung.mjs tools/native/test-ueberall.mjs tools/native/test-native-chrome.mjs tools/native/test-native-speech.mjs tools/native/test-native-translate.mjs && node tools/native/test-netz.mjs
